sources.recipe: INDEX is the plain code (VIX, VIX1D, VIX9D, VIX3M, VIX6M, VIX1Y, VVIX, SKEW, OVX, GVZ, VXN, RVX). A leading underscore (/_VIX_History.csv) is 403: the code is VIX_History.csv. sources.recipe: Use the .csv path (the .txt form is 403). Files exist only for settlement dates that have already been published (roughly the 15th and the last business day, with a publication lag), so probe backwards from the anchor and treat 403 as "not published yet", exactly like the repo's _si_resolve does.

decisions_resolved: PRICE LAYER (ruled: keep Eastmoney/Sina/Tencent, and add a Tiingo key the user supplied). The grey free layer stays and keeps its flag; Tiingo becomes the second US price source with published terms. Nothing in the HK price layer changes.
FREE VENDOR KEY (ruled: check whether Tiingo carries it). Tiingo is now wired as tiingo_eod_actions; the run-through in section 9 records exactly what its free plan returns.

HK AUTHORISED MATERIALS (ruled: cannot provide). HK point-in-time fundamentals and HK event-driven work are therefore permanent gaps unless a licensed HK feed is bought. Do not raise this again as an open question.

YAHOO (ruled: we are personal research, but no Hong Kong data from Yahoo). Yahoo is removed from every HK path: HK klines, HK ex-dividend/split dates and HK analyst estimates all go back to the gap list. Yahoo is also NOT wired into the default US chain; it stays a documented last resort only, because Tiingo and Finnhub now cover the US role.
